title: Implement Blog Preview section variant (blog-preview-cards)
description: Implement a Blog Preview section showing 3 recent blog post preview cards with title, excerpt, date, and optional image.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts `{ content: BlogPreviewContent, business: BusinessInfo }` props
Renders up to 3 blog post cards with title, excerpt, date, optional image
Card links are placeholder (#) since this is a demo site
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Create `src/components/shared/blog_preview/BlogPreviewCards.tsx`, `index.ts`. Grid of 3 cards `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3`. Each card: image (if present) at top, date (small muted), title (h3), excerpt (truncated to 3 lines), 'Read More' link. Card: border, hover shadow.
Take Playwright screenshot. Verify 3 cards are visible with title, excerpt, date.
